This script generates summary tables of the R/S split between specimens and fungal lineages

```{r setup, include=FALSE, message=F}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
subdir_name <- "Rscripts/7_group_analysis"
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(janitor)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

data = here::here("data")
results_path = here::here("results")

```

```{r knit, echo = F,eval=F,warning=F,include=F}
results_path = here::here("results")
rmarkdown::render(input = here("scripts", str_c(subdir_name, ".Rmd")), output_dir = results_path)
```

# Load data
```{r environmental, echo= F}

df <- read.csv(glue::glue("{data}/2026_meta_info.csv")) %>% 
  select(-1) %>%
  mutate(across(c(itc,pos,vrc,dif,pth,teb,pro), ~ gsub('32','>16',.x))) %>% 
  mutate(lineage = case_when(species == 'aspergillus niger' ~ 'ANL',
                             species == 'aspergillus tubingensis' ~ 'ATL',
                             species == 'aspergillus brasiliensis' ~ 'ABL',
                             T ~ NA))


df_info <- df %>% 
  select(specimen_types) %>% group_by(specimen_types) %>% summarise(n(), n()/78,n()/165)
```

# Set-up parameters
```{r functions}
source(here("src", "theme.R"))
source(here("src", "MIC_plot_functions.R"))
```

# Organize the MIC levels
```{r process}
mic_levels  <- c("0.031", "0.062", "0.125", "0.25", "0.5", "1", "2", "4", "8", "16", ">16")
mic_columns <- c("itc", "pos", "vrc", "vor", "teb", "pro", "dif", "pth")
# Function to apply this order to a column
reorder_column_fixed <- function(x) {
  factor(x, levels = mic_levels, ordered = TRUE)
}
# List of MIC columns in your dataframe
# Apply to all MIC columns
for (col in mic_columns) {
  if (col %in% names(df)) {
    df[[col]] <- reorder_column_fixed(df[[col]])
  }
}
df_sp <- df %>% filter(species %in% c('aspergillus niger','aspergillus tubingensis'))



```


#Create table 

```{r table}
breakpoints <- c(itc = 2, vrc = 4, pos = 0.5, pro = 8, pth =4, dif = 16, teb =16)

table_df = df %>% 
  mutate(across(c(itc,pos,vrc,dif,pth,teb,pro), ~ as.numeric(gsub('>16','32',.x)))) %>% 
  mutate(groups = case_when(origin == 'Clinical' & location == 'The Netherlands' ~ 'NL Clinical',
                            origin == 'Clinical' & location == 'Belgium'         ~ 'BE Clinical',
                            specimen_types == 'Environmental (hotspot)'          ~ 'Hotspot',
                            specimen_types == 'Environmental'          ~ 'Environmental',
                            T ~ NA)) %>% 
  select(groups, lineage, itc:pth) %>% 
  group_by(groups,lineage) %>% 
   summarise(
    Total_In_Group = n(),
    # We create two results for every column: NWT count and Total Tested count
    across(itc:pth, list(
      nwt = ~ sum(.x > breakpoints[cur_column()], na.rm = TRUE),
      tested = ~ sum(!is.na(.x))
    ), .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"),
    
    .groups = "drop"
  )

table_final <- table_df %>%
  mutate(across(ends_with("_nwt"), 
                ~ paste0(.x, "/", get(gsub("_nwt", "_tested", cur_column()))),
                .names = "{gsub('_nwt', '_ratio', .col)}")) %>%
  # Optionally select only the columns you want to show
  select(groups, lineage, Total_In_Group, contains("_ratio"))

head(table_final)

```

# Build tables
```{r tables}
env_sp_tub <- df_sp %>% filter(origin == "Environmental" & species =='aspergillus tubingensis' ) %>% pull(strain)
cli_sp_tub <- df_sp %>% filter(origin == "Clinical" & species =='aspergillus tubingensis' ) %>%  pull(strain)


itc_res <- df_sp %>% filter(itc > breakpoints['itc']  & species =='aspergillus tubingensis' ) %>%  pull(strain)
itc_sens <- df_sp %>% filter(itc <= breakpoints['itc'] & species =='aspergillus tubingensis' ) %>%  pull(strain)


pos_res <- df_sp %>% filter(pos > breakpoints['pos'] & species =='aspergillus tubingensis' ) %>%  pull(strain)
pos_sens <- df_sp %>% filter(pos <= breakpoints['pos'] & species =='aspergillus tubingensis' ) %>%  pull(strain)

vrc_res <- df_sp %>% filter(vrc > breakpoints['vrc'] & species =='aspergillus tubingensis' ) %>%  pull(strain)
vrc_sens <- df_sp %>% filter(vrc <= breakpoints['vrc'] & species =='aspergillus tubingensis' ) %>%  pull(strain)
```

# Save the files
```{r}
dir_res = here::here("results/group_analysis")
writeLines(env_sp_tub, con = glue::glue("{dir_res}/env.txt"))
writeLines(cli_sp_tub, con = glue::glue("{dir_res}/cli.txt"))

writeLines(itc_res, con = glue::glue("{dir_res}/itc_res.txt"))
writeLines(itc_sens, con = glue::glue("{dir_res}/itc_sens.txt"))

writeLines(pos_res, con = glue::glue("{dir_res}/pos_res.txt"))
writeLines(pos_sens, con = glue::glue("{dir_res}/pos_sens.txt"))

writeLines(vrc_res, con = glue::glue("{dir_res}/vrc_res.txt"))
writeLines(vrc_sens, con = glue::glue("{dir_res}/vrc_sens.txt"))


```
